survey.notes: 111 of 556 known pages surveyed; stopped at saturation (last new feature on page 84). Site-wide: svg:icon 98%, ui:input 98%, ui:form 97% (the footer subscribe form and the header search), layout:logo-wall 95% (the footer social-icon row, not a client logo wall), layout:card-grid 88%, ui:choice/disclosure/tabs 82%, ui:breadcrumb and ui:current-page-marker 80% (the marketplace filter sidebar, sort tabs and the pill current-page marker). One-offs: motion (animation 5%, loop 4%, marquee 2%), media:lottie 2% (home/about mascot), ui:carousel 2%, ui:code-block 2%, layout:banded-sections 1%, ui:table 1%. The pink primary button (#FF90E8, 1px black, 4px radius) is on 105 of 111 pages; black-filled and outlined 4px buttons and black-bordered pill tabs on 90-94. The 89 marketplace pages are mostly other people's product covers (imageShare 0.29-0.30) - their chrome (colored category band, black hairline filter panel, pink price flag) is the design; the covers are not. Full-page captures (re-captured, same keys p1-p12) now reach the footer on every page: home/about 7935px, pricing 5917px, features 9476px, small-bets 6138px, ping 3901px, help 7535px, api 117148px. Remaining gaps: the Lottie mascot was never filmed (motion.json visual empty), the sticker art is SVG images so no markup was captured, no modal/toast/error state was opened, and the pricing FAQ was captured closed only.

character.summary: A loud, cheerful storefront drawn with a black felt-tip: every surface is a flat field of paper, white or one saturated poster color (bubblegum pink, lemon, marigold, periwinkle, teal) held together by 1px pure-black hairlines and 4px corners, with no gradients and no soft shadows. Its objects are chunky ink-outlined stickers - thick tilted coins, curling receipts, die-cut word badges sitting on a solid black offset slab - plus flat cartoon vignettes, scattered around huge friendly grotesk headlines (72-96px, weight 500, sentence case) that talk about money in plain words, and long pages alternate color | black split bands down to a pink closing band and a black footer. Things respond physically: hover pops a button up and to the left so a hard black offset shadow, or a stack of colored plates, appears beneath it, and pressing slams it flat again.

color.notes: Two color systems sit side by side. Chrome is strictly ink + paper + white: black text, 1px black borders, black or white fills. Color arrives as whole flat fields - a full-bleed hero band, a category header, a split band, a sticker fill - never as gradients or soft tints. Correction from the full captures: on the black half of a split band, the section headings are set in a band color (periwinkle #90A8ED on pricing/features, marigold #FFC900 on features) with white body text (screenshots/p2, p3, p6 desktop light); and marigold is used as a highlighter block behind bold phrases in quotes (p6). Colored text appears nowhere else - never on paper or white. Pink is the one action color and appears 1-3 times per screen (primary button, price flag, focus ring, selected option border). Band colors are chosen per page or per category (marketplace headers: teal for 3D, lemon for music) and always carry black text. Surfaces stack paper (#F4F4F0) -> white card with 1px black border; never white-on-white without a hairline. Dark (prefers-color-scheme): chrome inverts (page #000 on marketing, #242423 on app pages; cards #000; text #DDDDDD; hairlines white at 35%), the primary action switches from black fill to pink fill, the current-page pill flips from black to white, and saturated bands and stickers stay exactly the same colors with black text and black outlines (screenshots p2/p3 dark). Illustrated dashboards (p1, p3) show the brand's own data styling: stats as big plain numbers with a small round dot legend (grey, dark grey, pink), a pink line series with dot markers over light-grey bars with dark-grey caps.

OFL monospace with plain forms; the reference uses a system mono with no styling of its own.

shape.notes: radius histogram: 4px 61.7%, pill 33.8%, 24px 1.6%, 16px 1.4%, 8px 0.8%, 2px 0.45%. Corners are almost square: 4px reads as a crisp printed edge, and the only round things are pills (status of 'where you are') and the big marketing cards. Border width is 1px everywhere (77.5% of bordered elements); the 15px value in styles.json (4.2%) could not be tied to a visible element and is ignored. Empty states use a 1px dashed black border (screenshots/p9-desktop-light.png). Full captures: the 24px marketing cards use a softer #919191 1px hairline (pixel sample p1), the only grey border on the site; testimonial cards are speech bubbles - 24px on three corners and a square corner toward the avatar below (p1). All product/app boxes (help tiles, ping table, docs panels, filter stack, small-bets quote wall) use pure #000.

motion.reducedMotion: Reference: the marquee runs only inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) (motion-safe:animate-[marquee_60s...]); motion-reduce:animate-none and motion-reduce:transition-none remove animation and transitions. Template: under reduce, stickers stay in place (no drift), marquees stop at their start, hover lifts become an instant shadow swap with no translate transition, disclosures open without animation.
motion.notes: Motion is sparse and physical, not decorative: things move like paper - lifted, slammed down, sliding past. Durations: 150ms for hover lift (67.8% of transitions), 200ms decelerate for opening (23.9%), 100ms micro, 300ms rare. No fades, no scroll reveals of content, no spinners observed (a spin keyframe exists but unused). The Lottie mascot was not filmed (motion.json visual is empty); its description comes from the raw file only.

layout.grid: 12-column, centered max widths by page kind: 1152px marketing (home/about/features), 1216px pricing, 1312px marketplace (64px gutters at 1440), 1376px docs/help (32px gutters), 1024px article column; app pages use a 1/4 sidebar (filters, docs nav, categories) + 3/4 content split; help cards 4-up, product cards 3-up beside the filter column.
layout.notes: Breakpoints at 640/768/1024/1280/1536px (styles.json mediaQueries). Marketing: centered hero, headline max ~900px, body lead 24px centered, generous 96-128px bands. App: dense top-aligned layouts with 16px rhythm; header 80px with a 1px black bottom rule; page title area on paper with a 1px black rule underneath before content (p7, p8, p12). Mobile: hamburger (two 3px bars), full-width 56px buttons, bands stack, sidebar becomes stacked boxes above content (screenshots/p9-mobile-light.png). Full captures: marketing pages are long stacks - hero band, centered section intro (eyebrow 16px + 72px heading + 24px lead) on white, checkerboard split bands, FAQ, pink closing band, black footer (p2, p3, p6); help index is section headings (20px/600) over 4-up 160px tile grids repeated about 8 times (p10); docs are a 1024px column with a bordered table (p7) or a 1/4 link sidebar + 3/4 stacked panels (p8).

theming.notes: color-scheme: light dark on the root, 5 @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) rules, Tailwind dark: variants; no toggle found on any captured page. In dark: page #000 (marketing) or #242423 (app/help/docs), cards and inputs #000, text #DDDDDD, hairlines rgba(221,221,221,.35), muted text white at 50%; black primary buttons and the header CTA block become pink #FF90E8 with black text; the current nav pill becomes white with black text; hard shadows become 4px 4px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35); the wordmark inverts; saturated bands, stickers and the pink focus ring are unchanged.

imagery.iconography: Small solid (filled) glyphs, 16-24px, pure black (white in dark): magnifier (2px stroke, round caps), chevrons, arrows, star, bookmark, file, box; social glyphs as black square tiles. Checkmarks in the home features sit in 24px pink circles with a 2px black outline. Arrows in pink buttons are text glyphs. No colored or duotone icons in app chrome. (reference/icons/p1-icons.png, p5-icons.png, inventory.json svgs: strokeWidths 2px, linecaps round)
imagery.illustration: Sticker objects: thick, flat, 3D-extruded everyday objects (coins seen at an angle with a visible rim, curling paper receipts, brushes, browser windows, dice) drawn with an even ~2px black outline that also draws the inner rim/fold lines, filled with one flat saturated color per object (pink, lemon, marigold, white), no shading, no gradient, no texture. Objects are large (130-260px), tilted, cropped by the edges and scattered in a loose ring around the headline, never touching text. A second register, on home tag marquees, uses small colored sticker icons with a white die-cut border and black outline. A rubber-hose mascot (pink head, 3px black outlines, thick lemon limbs with round caps) appears once as Lottie. Illustrations are SVG images (inventory.json images ext svg), so their markup was not captured; the description comes from screenshots.
imagery.photography: None by the brand. Marketplace imagery is creators' product covers (not the design), shown edge-to-edge inside 1px black card frames with no radius or filter. Home shows a product-page mockup illustration in a browser frame with a black offset edge.

signatures.name: Lift-and-slam hard shadow
signatures.what: Clickable things are paper cutouts: at rest a 1px #000 border and no shadow; on hover the element moves up-left 4px and a hard 4px 4px 0 #000 shadow appears beneath it (no blur, no spread); on press it lands flat (translate 0, no shadow). Marketing CTAs use a louder version: the button jumps -8px -8px and reveals two same-size plates beneath it - lemon #F1F333 at -4px and red #DC341E at 0 - each with its own 1px black border and 4px radius, like a stack of colored cards.
signatures.frequency: Every page: the pink button is on 105/111 surveyed pages, outline/black buttons on 94; the hard-shadow lift was measured on help, help article and marketplace header buttons, the plate stack on home, about, pricing, features and small-bets CTAs and the footer arrow button. The full captures add the same vocabulary at rest in illustrations: UI mockups, app tiles and stickers sit on a solid black offset slab (p1, p3, p6), so the hard offset is the site's only notion of depth.
signatures.recipe: Hard lift (default): .btn { border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:4px; transition: translate 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .btn:hover { translate:-4px -4px; box-shadow:4px 4px 0 0 var(--ink); } .btn:active { translate:0 0; box-shadow:none; } Dark: shadow color rgba(255,255,255,.35). Plate stack (hero CTA only): wrap the button in a position:relative inline-block; add two aria-hidden siblings absolutely positioned at inset:0 with the button's radius and 1px ink border - plate A background var(--lemon), plate B background var(--red) - z-index below the button; on wrapper hover translate the button -8px -8px and plate A -4px -4px (plate B stays). Plates are invisible at rest because they sit exactly under the button. Colors by role: plate A = band lemon, plate B = plate red; never pink for a plate (pink is the action). Applies to the element's own box, so works for buttons, cards, tiles and list rows of any size.
signatures.motion: hover: translate 0 -> -4px -4px (plates: -8px / -4px / 0), box-shadow none -> 4px 4px 0 #000, 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); press: back to 0 with the shadow removed (same 150ms). Reduced motion: no translate transition - swap shadow instantly (or show a 2px ink outline) and keep layout still.

Reduced motion: no movement.

signatures.name: Ink-outlined sticker objects
signatures.what: Big flat objects - coins with a thick visible rim, curling receipts, tools, dice - drawn as 3D-ish extrusions with an even ~2px black outline that also draws inner edges, each filled with one flat saturated color (pink #FF90E8 coins on paper, lemon #F1F333 coins on marigold, white receipts on lemon, lemon tools on pink). 130-260px, rotated 15-60 degrees, cropped by the viewport and scattered around a centered headline; on scroll the whole layer drifts upward faster than the page. The full captures add two registers of the same drawing: die-cut badges with a condensed hand-lettered word (two-color: lemon/marigold letters with pink or teal fills) and currency-symbol cut-outs, each resting on a solid black slab offset 6-10px down-right; and flat cartoon vignettes - circle-cropped scenes with ink-outlined characters and a white speech-bubble caption - inside marketing cards and split bands.
signatures.frequency: Every brand-designed marketing page, hero and below: heroes (home, about, pricing, features), every color half of the checkerboard bands (features x4, pricing, small-bets x2), the process ribbons (3 pages), the tag marquee and the home vignette cards. media:large-image is on 10% of surveyed pages, but these pages are the brand's whole marketing surface.
signatures.recipe: Draw original inline SVGs, never the reference's art. Pick an object from the product's own domain (a coin for money, a folder for files, a ticket for events, a bolt for speed). Construction: a front face shape + an offset copy shifted 8-16px down/right forming the rim/extrusion, joined by two tangent lines; inner detail as 1-3 strokes (an inner ring, fold lines, ruled lines). All strokes stroke:var(--ink) stroke-width 2 (at 200px size; keep ~1% of object size) stroke-linejoin:round stroke-linecap:round fill: one band color per object; rim face same color (no darker shade). No gradients, no texture, no drop shadow. Placement: position:absolute layer, pointer-events:none, aria-hidden, behind content (z-index 0), 4-6 objects per hero at the four corners and one breaking the band's bottom edge; rotate each with transform:rotate(-60..60deg); let 20-40% of each go off-canvas. Color rule: sticker fill must differ from the band it sits on (pink on paper, lemon on marigold, white on lemon). Drift: .stickers { animation: drift linear both; animation-timeline: scroll(root); } @keyframes drift { to { transform: translateY(-50%) } } (fallback: no movement). Badge variant: a die-cut outline shape (blob, starburst, rounded rectangle) filled with one band color, a word in a tall condensed display face with its own ink outline in a second band color, and a solid ink copy of the outline shape offset 8px right and 8px down beneath it. Vignette variant: a circle (or rectangle) clip of a flat scene in 3-4 band colors with ink outlines, and a white 1px-ink caption pill overlapping its top or bottom edge.
signatures.motion: Scroll-linked: layer translateY 0 -> -50% over the scroll range (linear, scroll timeline, duration 0 in motion.json). No idle animation on the stickers themselves. Reduced motion: static.

signatures.name: Hard-seamed poster color bands
signatures.what: Whole sections are single flat saturated fields - marigold #FFC900, lemon #F1F333, periwinkle #90A8ED, teal #23A094, pink #FF90E8, or black - that meet each other and the page at 1px #000 rules, sometimes split 50/50 vertically (periwinkle | teal on pricing; black | marigold on small-bets). App headers are bands too: each marketplace category has its own band color (teal for 3D, lemon for music) under which the page returns to paper. Text on every band is black (white only on the black band). Long pages alternate the split sides like a checkerboard (color | black, black | color) and close with a full pink band before the black footer. On the black halves the headings take a band color (periwinkle or marigold) with white body text.
signatures.frequency: Opening band on all 89 marketplace pages (80% of the survey) and on pricing, features, small-bets; checkerboard split bands on features (4 rows), pricing and small-bets; pink closing band on pricing, features, small-bets; black footer band on every page.
signatures.recipe: Tokens: band.marigold #FFC900, band.lemon #F1F333, band.periwinkle #90A8ED, band.teal #23A094, band.pink #FF90E8, band.ink #000. A band = <section> full-bleed, background one band token, border-bottom 1px solid var(--ink) (and border-top when it follows another band), padding 64-128px block on marketing, 24-32px on app headers, content centered inside the page max width. Split band: display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; with a 1px ink border-left on the second half; each half its own token; stack on mobile with a 1px ink rule between. Assign one band color per area of the product (a section, a category, a workspace) and keep it there, so color means 'where you are'. Text and borders on bands stay ink; buttons on bands keep their own fills (black, white, pink). In dark the bands keep the same colors and ink text. Checkerboard: stack split bands and swap which side is black on each row; the black half holds 48px headings in the band color of the adjacent half with 20px white text, the color half holds one illustration or sticker cluster. Close a long page with one pink band (72px headline + white outline button) before the black footer.

signatures.name: Ink hairline frame with pill markers
signatures.what: Structure is drawn, not shaded: every card, panel, input, filter box and list is a white box with a 1px pure-black border and 4px corners on a #F4F4F0 paper ground; groups are boxes divided by 1px black rules; empty states use a 1px dashed black box. Position is shown with pills: the current nav item is a filled black pill (white in dark), current tabs and chips are 1px black outline pills, 40px tall, 9999px radius. No soft shadows anywhere.
signatures.frequency: Site-wide: borderWidth 1px on 77.5% of bordered elements, border color #000 49%, radius 4px 61.7% and pill 33.8% (styles.json); current-page-marker on 80% of pages, tabs 82%. signatures.recipe: Ground body var(--paper) #F4F4F0; surfaces var(--surface) #FFF with border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:4px; no box-shadow. Grouped controls: one bordered box, children separated by border-top:1px solid var(--ink) (divide-y), rows 56px with 16px padding. Section rules: full-bleed 1px ink line under the header and under the page-title area. Pills: height 40px; padding 8px 12px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid transparent; current = border-color var(--ink) (on bands add background #FFF); primary nav current = background var(--ink), color #FFF. Empty: border:1px dashed var(--ink); centered 16px solid icon + 16px sentence. Dark: surfaces #000 on #242423 (or page #000), borders rgba(221,221,221,.35), pills white-filled.
signatures.motion: Pill outline appears instantly on hover (0ms); disclosure chevrons rotate in 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1).

signatures.name: Notched pink price flag
signatures.what: A pink #FF90E8 label with 1px black border whose right end is cut into a swallowtail/arrow notch, holding a price in 16px black text (old price struck through before the new one). Sits bottom-left of every product card, paired with a black star rating bottom-right.
signatures.frequency: On every product card of the 89 marketplace pages (card-grid 88%). The marketing illustrations reuse it inside drawn product cards and plan pickers (p1, p3), so it reads as the brand's price mark.
signatures.recipe: Inline-flex label, height 28px, padding 0 20px 0 8px, background var(--pink), color var(--ink), 1px ink border on top/left/bottom; the right edge cut with clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 12px) 50%, 100% 100%, 0 100%) plus an SVG or pseudo-element stroke so the notch keeps a 1px ink outline (draw the shape as an inline SVG path with stroke 1px for a crisp edge). Text 16px/400 tabular numbers; discount = previous value with text-decoration: line-through then the new value. Same in dark (pink stays, text ink).

writing.casing: Sentence case everywhere: headlines, buttons ('Start selling', 'Log in', 'Contact support'), tabs, eyebrows; no all-caps, no title case except proper nouns and a few step labels.
writing.tone: Plain, upbeat and direct, second person, talks about money and first steps without jargon; short declarative sentences with a light joke at most.
writing.notes: Headlines are short (2-6 words) and often contain a number or currency figure; eyebrows are a single plain word above the headline, same font, 20px, no letter-spacing tricks. Buttons are 1-2 word verbs; arrow-only buttons use a text arrow glyph. Body leads end with a period. Empty states are one short sentence ('No X found' style). Never copy the reference's lines.
